description: This file defines a static code analysis inspection for Android XML files within the IntelliJ IDEA platform, specifically checking for unknown attributes in Android resource XML files.

classes.name: AndroidUnknownAttributeInspection
classes.description: A local inspection tool for detecting unknown Android XML attributes in IntelliJ IDEA.

classes.name: MyVisitor
classes.description: An internal visitor class that traverses XML attributes to identify and report unknown attributes.

methods.name: getGroupDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the inspection group.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of this specific inspection.

methods.name: getShortName
methods.description: Returns the short identifier name for the inspection.

methods.name: checkFile
methods.description: Performs the inspection on a given file, returning problem descriptors for issues found.

methods.name: isMyFile
methods.description: Determines if the given file is relevant for this inspection based on resource type and root tag.
